description: This file defines a Fragment class 'DailyForecastFragment' for an Android weather forecast app. It handles displaying daily weather forecast data in a RecyclerView, manages UI elements like SwipeRefreshLayout for refresh gestures, and observes ViewModel data to update the UI accordingly. The inner adapter class handles data binding for each forecast day, formatting dates, weather conditions, and temperature ranges.

classes.name: DailyForecastFragment
classes.description: A Fragment displaying daily weather forecast data with refresh capabilities

classes.name: DailyForecastAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying each day's forecast information

classes.name: ViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class for DailyForecastAdapter managing item views

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes ViewModel, views, recycler view, swipe refresh, and sets up data observation

methods.name: initViews
methods.description: Finds and assigns views for swipe refresh and recycler view

methods.name: setupRecyclerView
methods.description: Initializes the adapter and layout manager for the RecyclerView

methods.name: observeForecastData
methods.description: Sets observers on forecast data and loading state to update UI

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set and refreshes view

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new ViewHolder instances for RecyclerView items

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds forecast data to view holder views for display

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of forecast days in the list

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds forecast day data to individual item views, including date formatting and temperature display
